summary: Iteration 147 - Import Module Testing Complete. Backend: 27/27 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified - hero, entity picker, upload step, map step, review step, jobs list. Permission gating working correctly (admin sees Import Module, receptionist does not).

tests: GET /api/imports/schemas returns 4 entities (bookings, guests, rooms, rate_plans)
Each entity has required, optional, all_fields arrays
POST /api/imports/parse parses CSV and returns file_token, headers, rows_count, sample_rows, auto_mapping, schema
Auto-mapping fuzzy-matches: Name→name, Email→email, Phone Number→phone
Rejects when required fields not mapped (400)
POST /api/imports/{id}/dry-run validates rows and returns total, valid, errors, preview
Detects invalid date format for bookings check_in/check_out
POST /api/imports/{id}/run inserts valid rows with id, _imported_from, _imported_at, created_at
Skips duplicates when skip_duplicates_by is set
GET /api/imports lists jobs with total count
GET /api/imports/{id} returns job detail with errors
Full import flow with test_guests.csv: parse→create→dry-run→run
Import Module button visible for admin (data-testid=import-module-btn)
Import Module button NOT visible for receptionist (permission-gated via settings_import_module_view)
Hero renders with 'Import anything. From any system.' title
'Competitor says Missing — we built it' badge displayed
KPIs show jobs count and imported total
Entity picker panel loads on 'New Import' click
4 entity cards displayed: bookings, guests, rooms, rate_plans
Each card shows gradient icon, required/optional counts
Upload step loads after entity selection
Map step loads after file upload
3 KPI cards: Total rows, Valid, Errors
Each job shows entity icon, status badge, summary, timestamp, created_by_name
Status badges: draft, dry_run, running, done, failed

critical_code_review_comments: Import Module implementation is complete and well-structured
Auto-mapping fuzzy logic correctly handles common CSV header variations
Role-based access control properly enforced (admin/manager only for parse/create/run/delete)
Dry-run validation catches missing required fields and invalid date formats
Duplicate skipping works correctly with skip_duplicates_by parameter
Frontend wizard flow is intuitive with clear step progression
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing
seed_data_creation: Test imports created during backend testing with unique UUIDs to avoid conflicts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 147 added Import Module for bulk importing bookings, guests, rooms, rate_plans from CSV/XLSX. Backend has 8 endpoints: GET /schemas, POST /parse, POST /imports (create), POST /{id}/dry-run, POST /{id}/run, GET /imports (list), GET /{id}, DELETE /{id}. Frontend has 4-step wizard: entity picker → upload → map → review. Permission-gated via settings_import_module_view (admin/manager only). Files cached in /tmp/imports/{token}.json. Supports .csv, .xlsx, .xls, .txt. Limits: 10k rows, 20MB.
